**PR supersession.** The first PR was #194 on the ticket-named branch
`r11/P34.2-recorded-ci-verifier-and-flake-policy` (`9880b5e` + repair
`cbe64b6`). Its CI did its job: the docs job's recorded-CI verifier flagged
21 false-positive stray `ci:` fragments in code/prose, and the boundary's
merge window ignored the boundary's own timestamp. The repair commit was
pushed without the OM-01 `Harness:` trailer, and the `r11/**`
`non_fast_forward` ruleset (no bypass actors; agents never force-push,
H1 §3.1) makes that commit unremovable from #194's `base...head` range — the
trailer check there is permanently red. #194 was closed unmerged with an
explanatory comment; the identical tree, every commit trailered, re-landed
on `r11/P34.2-recorded-ci-verifier-and-flake-policy-v2` as #195, whose range
is `9880b5e` + `9dbb26f` — both trailered — and is green above.
